skills.description: PowerShell security module: AES encryption and decryption, SHA hashing and file integrity, secure RNG, certificate generation, TLS, ACL inspection, and UAC hardening.
Guides a developer through adopting the agents.txt standard on their own website: walks the spec, picks an adoption path (hand-write, generator, or library), and validates the result.
Returns the newest memory rows, newest first, with no query. Grounds an agent in the latest activity across every entity, or scoped to one actor.
Records one memory row through the new_memory RPC so the next session starts warm: milestones, decisions, corrections, failures, and patterns worth carrying forward.
Runs a semantic search over the agent memory data plane and returns the closest memories, so an agent grounds in prior decisions and earlier failures before acting.

A polyglot documentation convention that generates markdown directly from source comments, using per-language markers: #### in PowerShell, //// in C# and JavaScript, ---- in SQL. Regenerate from source; never hand-edit the render.

Writing, editing, reviewing, and scoping software specifications: design docs, SRS, RFC, ADR, PRD, requirements lists, acceptance criteria, EARS requirements, RFC 2119 language, and Given-When-Then tests.
Shaping Markdown and generated documentation for readability: viewport width, visual hierarchy, scan rhythm, chunking, line length, tables, lists, code anchors, and mobile readability.
